source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.3.1 (PDF 197-198) with the insect example and the bar chart.

blocks.text: Bar chart (ya bar graph) data ki tasveeri shakal hai jis mein categorical data (qismon wala data, jaise species ke naam) mustateel (rectangle) bars se dikhaya jata hai; har bar ki lambai ya unchai us qeemat ke barabar nisbat (proportional) mein hoti hai jo woh dikhata hai. Bar charts alag alag qismon ya groups ki miqdar ka muqabla karne ke liye bante hain. Biology mein yeh mukhtalif species ki ginti, experiment ke groups, ya biological samples ki naap dikhane ke liye bohat kaam ke hain. Bar chart ki bunyadi khasiyatein:

items: Qismein (categories) x-axis (ufqi, horizontal lakeer) par hoti hain.
Qeematein ya frequencies y-axis (amoodi, vertical lakeer) par hoti hain.
Bars khari (vertical) ya leti (horizontal) dono tarah ban sakti hain.
